narr: Excessive rainfall develop from slow moving storms that tended to train over the same area. Precipitable water values were an excessive 2.2 inches.
ev: Cars were reported stalling in floodwaters on JK Powell Blvd at Washington St.
Water was flowing across Swamp Fox Highway near Chandler Worley Farm.
Parts of Halcyon Lane are impassable due to standing water.
